test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.**

Ross said to Rachel, “We were on a break”.

options.text: Ross told Rachel that they used to be on a break.
Ross told Rachel that they were on break.
Ross told Rachel that they had been on a break.
Ross told Rachel that they have been on a break.

solution:
The correct answer is: "**Ross told Rachel that they had been on a break.**"
